fields.subject: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg timestamp handling
fields.condition: a DateTime is written to or read from a timestamptz column by the membership or reminder table
fields.trigger: a write binds the value, or a read maps it
fields.response: Kind Utc is sent unchanged, Kind Unspecified is taken as UTC with its clock reading kept, and Kind Local is converted with ToUniversalTime, each sent as a zero-offset DateTimeOffset; values read back are given Kind Utc
fields.postcondition: every stored timestamp is a UTC instant and every returned DateTime is Utc
